title: Ravens put Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens put Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic on IR
sources.description: The Ravens lost centers Jovaughn Gwyn and Ethan Pocic to long-term injuries in last Sunday's win over the Ravens and both players were moved to the injured reserve list on Saturday.
